fato_historico: 2024: A series of landslides occurs in Kerala, India, causing over 420 fatalities.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace deep transformation today. Just as the earth shifts and settles, you may find your inner landscape undergoing a powerful evolution. It is a good time to release what no longer serves your spirit. Consider the strength found in rebuilding and trust that you possess the resilience to navigate any terrain with grace.
frase_do_dia: Like the earth finding balance, your soul blooms even in shifting soils.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of inner wisdom through cycles of constant change.
conselho: Ground yourself in nature and honor the strength within your own heart today.
